result:
If I could change the world in one way, I would choose to make clean water and sanitation accessible to every person on the planet. 

Having access to clean drinking water and proper sanitation is a fundamental human right, yet millions of people around the world lack these basic necessities. This leads to a multitude of problems, including the spread of diseases, malnutrition, and even death. 

By making clean water and sanitation accessible to all, I believe we could significantly reduce the burden of water-borne illnesses, improve overall health and well-being, and create a more equitable and just world. 

It's a complex issue, but if I had to choose one way to change the world, this would be it! What about you, what would you change if you had the chance?
